/* UCI superconductivity Dataset page (product page): instrument -> raw -> transformation -> design matrix.
   Reads only D.stages. */
const S = D.stages, MX = S.matrix;
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const isOpen = id => PCFolds.isOpen($(id));
const fmtN = v => Number(v).toLocaleString();
const fmtV = v => v == null ? '—' : Math.abs(v) >= 1000 ? v.toFixed(1) : +(+v).toPrecision(6) + '';

function nice(lo, hi, n) {
  const step0 = (hi - lo) / (n || 5), mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(step0))), f = step0 / mag;
  const step = (f < 1.5 ? 1 : f < 3 ? 2 : f < 7 ? 5 : 10) * mag, out = [];
  for (let v = Math.ceil(lo / step - 1e-9) * step; v <= hi + 1e-9; v += step) out.push(+v.toFixed(10));
  return out;
}
function panel(cv, h, xr, yr, xl, yl, o) {
  o = o || {};
  const w = o.w || cv.parentElement.clientWidth || 600, g = PC.fit(cv, w, h);
  const sc = PC.scales(cv, xr, yr, o.pad || { l: 58, r: 14, t: 12, b: 46 });
  PC.drawAxes(g, sc, o.xt || nice(xr[0], xr[1], w < 480 ? 4 : 7), o.yt || nice(yr[0], yr[1], 4), sc.x, sc.y,
    xl, yl, { grid: 'both', xFmt: o.xFmt, yFmt: o.yFmt });
  return { g, sc, w, h };
}
function hbars(cv, items, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const w = cv.parentElement.clientWidth || 600, rh = opts.rh || 30, h = (opts.top || 12) + rh * items.length + 10;
  const g = PC.fit(cv, w, h), lw = Math.min(opts.lw || 190, w * 0.38), x0 = lw + 8, bw = w - x0 - 130;
  const max = Math.max(...items.map(q => q[1])), sc = opts.log ? v => Math.log10(v) / Math.log10(max) : v => v / max;
  if (opts.title) PC.tickText(g, opts.title, 0, 0, 'left', 'top');
  items.forEach(([label, v, hi], j) => {
    const y = (opts.top || 12) + j * rh, len = Math.max(2, sc(v) * bw), bh = rh - 10;
    PC.tickText(g, label, lw, y + bh / 2, 'right', 'middle');
    g.fillStyle = PC.css(hi ? '--stage-2' : '--axis'); g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(x0, y, len, bh, [0, 4, 4, 0]); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = PC.css('--text-primary'); g.font = PC.font.emph(); g.textAlign = 'left'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const lost = opts.lost && j ? items[j - 1][1] - v : 0;
    g.fillText(fmtN(v) + (lost ? '  (−' + fmtN(lost) + ')' : ''), x0 + len + 6, y + bh / 2);
  });
}

/* ---------- Raw data ---------- */
function paintRaw() {
  if (!isOpen('raw-data')) return;
  const tc = S.tc.values_sorted, lo = -4, hi = 2.5, nb = 52, bins = new Array(nb).fill(0);
  tc.forEach(v => { const k = Math.floor((Math.log10(v) - lo) / (hi - lo) * nb); bins[Math.max(0, Math.min(nb - 1, k))]++; });
  const P = panel($('tcPlot'), 220, [lo, hi], [0, Math.max(...bins) * 1.08], 'Critical temperature (K, log scale)', 'Materials',
    { xt: [-4, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2], xFmt: v => (10 ** v) >= 1 ? String(10 ** v) : (10 ** v).toPrecision(1) });
  const bw = P.sc.iw / nb; P.g.fillStyle = PC.css('--series-1');
  bins.forEach((b, k) => P.g.fillRect(P.sc.p.l + k * bw + 0.5, P.sc.y(b), Math.max(1, bw - 1), P.sc.y(0) - P.sc.y(b)));
  PC.hover($('tcPlot'), bins.map((b, k) => [P.sc.p.l + (k + 0.5) * bw, P.sc.y(b / 2), k]), {
    radius: 20, onHit: (k, evt) => PC.tip((10 ** (lo + k * (hi - lo) / nb)).toPrecision(2) + '–' + (10 ** (lo + (k + 1) * (hi - lo) / nb)).toPrecision(2) + ' K<br>' + fmtN(bins[k]) + ' materials', evt),
    onLeave: () => PC.hideTip()
  });
  hbars($('elPlot'), S.elements.names.map((e, k) => [e, S.elements.counts[k]]), { rh: 20, lw: 60, title: 'Materials containing the element', top: 18 });
  hbars($('nPlot'), S.n_el_hist.map((c, k) => [k + (k === 1 ? ' element' : ' elements'), c]).filter(q => q[1] > 0), { rh: 24, lw: 110, title: 'Elements per formula', top: 18 });
}

/* ---------- Transformation ---------- */
function paintFunnel() {
  if (!isOpen('transformation')) return;
  hbars($('funnel'), [['SuperCon snapshot (documented)', 31611], ['After Hamidieh’s cleaning', S.n_rows], ['Rows of the matrix', S.n_rows, true]], { lost: true, lw: 210 });
}
const mSel = $('matSelect'), pSel = $('propSelect');
S.examples.forEach((e, k) => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = k; o.textContent = e.material + ' · ' + e.why; mSel.appendChild(o); });
S.props.forEach(([key, name]) => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = key; o.textContent = name; pSel.appendChild(o); });
const STAT_LABEL = { mean: 'mean', wtd_mean: 'weighted mean', gmean: 'geometric mean', wtd_gmean: 'weighted geometric mean', entropy: 'entropy',
  wtd_entropy: 'weighted entropy', range: 'range', wtd_range: 'weighted range', std: 'standard deviation', wtd_std: 'weighted standard deviation' };
function paintMaterial() {
  if (!isOpen('transformation')) return;
  const e = S.examples[+mSel.value], key = pSel.value, prop = S.props.find(p => p[0] === key);
  $('matReadout').textContent = 'Row ' + fmtN(e.row) + ' of both files · ' + e.n_el + (e.n_el === 1 ? ' element' : ' elements') + ' · kept, as every material is.';
  $('mRaw').innerHTML = '<p><b>' + e.material + '</b></p><p>critical temperature <b>' + fmtV(e.tc) + ' K</b></p><p>' + e.elements.map((el, k) => el + ' ' + e.amount[k]).join(' · ') + '</p>';
  propBars($('mProp'), e.elements.map((el, k) => [el, e.p[k]]));
  $('mVals').innerHTML = '<thead><tr><th>Element</th><th>p</th><th>' + prop[1] + ' (' + prop[2] + ')</th><th>p · t</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
    + e.elements.map((el, k) => '<tr><td>' + el + '</td><td>' + e.p[k].toFixed(4) + '</td><td>' + fmtV(e.props[key][k]) + '</td><td>' + fmtV(e.p[k] * e.props[key][k]) + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody>';
  $('mStats').innerHTML = '<thead><tr><th>Statistic</th><th>Rebuilt</th><th>Released</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>'
    + S.stats.map(s => { const a = e.rebuilt[key][s], b = e.file[key][s], ok = Math.abs(a - b) <= Math.max(1e-6 * Math.abs(b), 1e-4);
      return '<tr><td>' + STAT_LABEL[s] + '</td><td>' + fmtV(a) + '</td><td>' + fmtV(b) + '</td><td>' + (ok ? '<span class="okmark">✓ identical</span>' : '<b>differs</b>') + '</td></tr>'; }).join('')
    + '<tr><td>number of elements</td><td>' + e.n_el + '</td><td>' + e.n_el + '</td><td><span class="okmark">✓ identical</span></td></tr></tbody>';
}
/* Proportions need decimals, unlike the count bars. */
function propBars(cv, items) {
  const w = cv.parentElement.clientWidth || 300, rh = 26, h = 12 + rh * items.length + 10, g = PC.fit(cv, w, h), lw = 50, x0 = lw + 8, bw = w - x0 - 70;
  items.forEach(([label, v], j) => {
    const y = 12 + j * rh; PC.tickText(g, label, lw, y + 8, 'right', 'middle');
    g.fillStyle = PC.css('--series-1'); g.beginPath(); g.roundRect(x0, y, Math.max(2, v * bw), 16, [0, 4, 4, 0]); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = PC.css('--text-primary'); g.font = PC.font.emph(); g.textAlign = 'left'; g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.fillText(v.toFixed(3), x0 + v * bw + 6, y + 8);
  });
}

/* ---------- Design matrix ---------- */
const NF = S.features.length, Q = Uint8Array.from(atob(MX.rank_u8_b64), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
let hmImg = null, hmTheme = null, hmRow = Math.floor(S.n_rows / 2);
function heatImage() {
  const t = PC.isDark() ? 'd' : 'l';
  if (hmImg && hmTheme === t) return hmImg;
  const ramp = PC.rampScale(), lut = [];
  for (let k = 0; k <= 254; k++) lut.push((ramp(k / 254).match(/\d+/g) || [0, 0, 0]).map(Number));
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = NF; c.height = S.n_rows;
  const cx = c.getContext('2d'), img = cx.createImageData(NF, S.n_rows);
  for (let k = 0; k < Q.length; k++) { const p = lut[Q[k]]; img.data.set([p[0], p[1], p[2], 255], k * 4); }
  cx.putImageData(img, 0, 0); hmImg = c; hmTheme = t; return c;
}
function paintHeat() {
  if (!isOpen('matrix')) return;
  const cv = $('mxHeat'), w = cv.parentElement.clientWidth || 600, h = 440, g = PC.fit(cv, w, h);
  const L = 62, R = 12, T = 8, B = 44, iw = w - L - R, ih = h - T - B, tc = S.tc.values_sorted;
  g.imageSmoothingEnabled = false; g.drawImage(heatImage(), L, T, iw, ih);
  [1, 10, 30, 90].forEach(k => { const r = tc.findIndex(v => v >= k); if (r >= 0) PC.tickText(g, k + ' K', L - 6, T + r / S.n_rows * ih, 'right', 'middle'); });
  S.props.forEach(([key, name], j) => { const c0 = 1 + j * 10; g.strokeStyle = PC.css('--surface-1'); g.lineWidth = 1; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(L + c0 / NF * iw, T); g.lineTo(L + c0 / NF * iw, T + ih); g.stroke(); });
  PC.tickText(g, 'columns: number of elements, then 10 statistics for each of 8 properties', L + iw / 2, T + ih + 8, 'center', 'top');
  PC.tickText(g, 'rows ordered by critical temperature (low → high)', L + iw / 2, T + ih + 24, 'center', 'top');
  g.strokeStyle = PC.css('--text-primary'); g.lineWidth = 1.5; g.strokeRect(L - .5, T + hmRow / S.n_rows * ih - 1.5, iw + 1, 3);
  const r = hmRow, orig = MX.order[r];
  $('mxReadout').textContent = 'Row ' + fmtN(orig) + ' · ' + MX.material[orig] + ' · ' + fmtV(tc[r]) + ' K';
  cv.onpointermove = evt => {
    const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), y = evt.clientY - b.top, x = evt.clientX - b.left;
    if (y < T || y > T + ih || x < L) return;
    const row = Math.min(S.n_rows - 1, Math.floor((y - T) / ih * S.n_rows)), col = Math.min(NF - 1, Math.floor((x - L) / iw * NF));
    if (row !== hmRow) { hmRow = row; paintHeat(); }
    PC.tip('<b>' + MX.material[MX.order[row]] + '</b><br>' + S.features[col] + '<br>percentile ' + Math.round(Q[row * NF + col] / 254 * 100) + ' in its column', evt);
  };
  cv.onpointerleave = () => PC.hideTip();
}

mSel.addEventListener('change', paintMaterial);
pSel.addEventListener('change', paintMaterial);
PC.registerRepaint(() => { paintRaw(); paintFunnel(); paintMaterial(); paintHeat(); });
PC.repaint('initial', document);
